title: AI Agent Builder / Developer
description:
AI Agent Developer | AI Automation Developer | AI Solutions Developer

Remote or Hybrid | Highly Competitive Salary | Negotiable for Exceptional Talent

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is partnering with a rapidly growing international technology business, supporting customers in more than 70 countries, to recruit an ambitious AI Agent Developer.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business investing heavily in AI, intelligent automation and emerging technologies. You'll have the freedom to design, build and deploy AI-powered agents that solve real-world business challenges, streamline operations and help shape the next generation of digital transformation.

Whether you've built advanced automations commercially, developed your own AI projects or have a passion for creating intelligent systems, we'd love to hear from you.

What We Offer
  • Highly competitive salary.
  • Salary negotiable for exceptional talent.
  • Remote-first culture.
  • Hybrid working flexibility available.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative AI projects with real-world impact.
  • Freedom to experiment with the latest AI tools and technologies.
  • Opportunity to join a business actively investing in automation and AI capabilities.
  • Fast-moving environment where ideas can quickly become reality.
  • Significant opportunity for growth within an expanding international business.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and build AI agents and autonomous workflows.
  • Create intelligent systems powered by GPT and other large language models.
  • Connect APIs, platforms and business applications into automated ecosystems.
  • Develop multi-step AI workflows capable of reasoning, decision-making and action execution.
  • Experiment with emerging AI frameworks, tools and technologies.
  • Rapidly prototype new solutions and bring innovative concepts into production.
  • Test, refine and optimise AI systems for performance and reliability.
  • Work alongside technical and commercial teams to solve complex business challenges.
Requirements

Essential:

  • Experience with platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Airtable or similar automation tools.
  • Genuine passion for AI, emerging technology and intelligent automation.
  • Strong understanding of AI agents, LLMs, prompt engineering and workflow orchestration.
  • Experience integrating APIs, webhooks and multiple software platforms.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a desire to continuously learn and experiment.
  • Enjoyment of building solutions and bringing ideas to life.

Desirable:

  • Experience with LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or OpenAI APIs.
  • Exposure to Python or scripting for automation.
  • Experience delivering AI, automation or digital transformation projects.
  • Understanding of vector databases, RAG architectures or agentic AI frameworks.
Interested?

If you're looking for your next opportunity as an AI Agent Developer, AI Automation Developer or AI Solutions Developer, apply today.


Acorn by Synergie acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment.
